frequency_question: How often are major 30-year transboundary water treaties successfully renewed or succeeded prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal, state-level treaties dividing shared river flows with explicitly mandated multi-decade review or expiration dates. Excludes informal understandings, unilateral diversions, and treaties without fixed long-term sunset clauses.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 2 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 2 named cases representing the complete population of major bilateral water treaties in the immediate geopolitical theater reaching multi-decade operational horizons.
known_gaps: Small population size limits statistical robustness, necessitating deep case-structure analysis over numerical frequency.
skeleton: Named historical bilateral water treaties reaching longevity milestones in the region
multiplier: 2 cases evaluated for structural renewal propensity
validity_reason: The base rate relies on long-term state treaty compliance patterns which shift slowly over multi-year diplomatic eras.
